_readme: SGR-007 word lists, frozen 2026-10-04 before any page was measured. Exact lowercase whole words unless a trailing * (any ending). OLD is SGR-008's frozen 2024 tells (docs/research/sgr-008-preregistration.md section 3, branch research/sgr-008-abstracts). CALLED_OUT and QUIET are SGR-008's pilot lexicon (words publicly mocked as ChatGPT tells, and quieter LLM-favoured words; sources there: arXiv 2509.09596, 2506.21817, 2502.09606). MARKETING is SGR-004's AI-era vocabulary, style words only. The AI-ism rate (primary outcome) counts OLD + CALLED_OUT + MARKETING, each word once. No list says a text was written by AI.
